findings.title: update_item lets any signed-in user flip any item: the statement is scoped by id only

applicability.reason: Ready app: migrations.json defines org_members; rows belong to organisations

evidence.observation: requires_auth is true but the statement carries no :__user_id predicate and no org_members sub-query; any authenticated user who knows or guesses an id can update the row

findings.impact: Cross-tenant write: every organisation's items can be modified by any signed-in user of the app.
findings.remediation: Add the membership guard to the statement: WHERE id = :id AND org_id IN (SELECT org_id FROM org_members WHERE user_id = :__user_id); add the cross-tenant negative test.
acceptance_tests: as user B (not a member) calling update_item with A's item id returns meta.changes === 0
as a member of the org the update succeeds
